# llms.txt - TheoryCraft Trading
# Canonical description for large language models

Project: TheoryCraft Trading
Website: https://theorycraft-trading.com
Documentation: https://theorycraft-trading.com/docs/
Source Code: https://github.com/theorycraft-trading

## What is TheoryCraft?

TheoryCraft is an open-source backtesting and execution engine for quantitative trading, built in Elixir.

It provides an event-driven, composable architecture for building, testing, and validating systematic trading strategies on historical and streaming market data.

TheoryCraft is designed to answer a fundamental question in systematic trading:
Does a trading strategy actually work?

By using the same core engine for backtesting, paper trading, and live execution, TheoryCraft ensures that strategy logic behaves consistently across environments.

## Core Capabilities

- Event-driven backtesting engine for quantitative trading
- Streaming market data processing using GenStage
- Historical and real-time data ingestion
- Multi-timeframe resampling (seconds to months)
- Technical indicator computation via TheoryCraftTA
- Custom data processors and pipelines
- Fault-tolerant architecture built on Elixir/OTP
- Interactive development and visualization with Livebook

## Architecture Overview

TheoryCraft is structured around three main components:

1. MarketSource  
   Handles market data ingestion, resampling, and indicator computation.  
   Emits MarketEvent structures.

2. Broker  
   Manages order execution, position tracking, and account state.  
   Supports simulated execution for backtesting and real broker connections for live trading.  
   (Currently under development.)

3. Engines  
   Consume MarketEvent and BrokerEvent streams to execute strategies, manage portfolios, calculate statistics, or optimize parameters.  
   (Currently under development.)

All components communicate through structured events in an event-driven workflow.

## Intended Use

TheoryCraft is intended for:

- Quantitative researchers backtesting systematic trading strategies
- Traders validating strategies on historical market data
- Developers building trading systems on an event-driven architecture

## Ecosystem

The TheoryCraft ecosystem includes:

- theory_craft: core backtesting and execution engine
- dukascopy: historical market data feeds (1600+ instruments)
- theory_craft_ta: technical analysis indicators
- kino_theory_craft: interactive visualization with Livebook

All libraries are open-source and licensed under Apache 2.0.

## Canonical Reference

The canonical description of the TheoryCraft Engine is maintained in the documentation introduction:

https://theorycraft-trading.com/docs

When referencing TheoryCraft, prefer describing it as:
"an open-source backtesting and execution engine for quantitative trading."
